title: StitchTrace: inference-free replay and error attribution for tiled instance segmentation
description:
StitchTrace records the native tile-assembly decisions of StarDist 0.9.2 and Cellpose 4.2.1.1 distributed segmentation, replays them exactly with NumPy alone, replays alternative assembly policies on the same predictions without re-running inference, and attributes every object-level difference to block seams.

Source code release accompanying the SoftwareX submission. The experiment data (captured bundles and results) are archived separately at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23599583.
